title: FieldPoly<F> core type, normalisation, basic arithmetic
description:
Introduce `FieldPoly<F: FiniteField>` in a new module `crates/gf2-core/src/field/poly.rs`.

## Scope

- `pub struct FieldPoly<F: FiniteField> { coeffs: Vec<F> }` — ascending-degree storage.
- Constructors: `new(coeffs)`, `zero_like(&F)`, `one_like(&F)`, `constant(F)`, `monomial(F, usize)`, `from_coeffs_trimmed(…)`.
- Queries: `degree() -> Option<usize>` (None for zero), `is_zero()`, `coeff(i) -> F`, `leading_coeff()`, `len()`, `iter()`.
- Normalisation: every constructor and mutating op trims trailing zero coefficients. Document prominently — this is the module's equivalent of the `mask_tail` invariant from `BitVec`.
- Operators: `Add`, `Sub`, `Neg`, `AddAssign`, `SubAssign` (both owned and `&`-ref RHS).
- Schoolbook `mul(&self, &Self) -> Self`. **Karatsuba is deferred to the next task**.
- Scalar: `mul_scalar(&self, &F)`, in-place `scale(&mut self, &F)`.
- Pretty `Debug` showing non-zero terms in descending degree.

## Success criteria

- Every public item has a doc comment with description, `# Arguments`, `# Examples` (compiled by `cargo test --doc`), `# Panics` if applicable, `# Complexity` for non-trivial ops.
- Unit tests: constructors, normalisation (trailing zeros), zero polynomial, degree of constant, schoolbook over `Fp<7>` and `Gf2mElement`.
- Proptests (≤64 cases each, to respect the 60s workspace-test budget): associativity `(a+b)+c == a+(b+c)`, distributivity `a*(b+c) == a*b + a*c`, `deg(a*b) == deg(a)+deg(b)` when neither is zero.
- Re-exported from `crates/gf2-core/src/field/mod.rs`.
- `#![deny(unsafe_code)]` preserved.

## Out of scope

- Karatsuba multiplication (separate task).
- Division, GCD, evaluation (separate task).
- Batch/NTT/interpolation (separate tasks).
